=={{int:filedesc}}== {{Information |description={{en|Throughout its 27-year history, Hubble has seen enough of the Universe to fill 100 episodes of the Hubblecast — 10 hours worth! These episodes have captured the science, culture, trials, and successes of Hubble, ranging from its spectacular images to its cutting-edge discoveries to its impact on society. This special 100th Hubblecast reflects on the past 99 episodes, and includes the smartest, funniest, weirdest and most creative moments. Credit :
Directed by: Mathias Jäger
Visual design and editing: Martin Kornmesser
Written by: Georgia Bladon, Mathias Jäger
Narration: Jochen Liske
Presented: Dr J (Jochen Liske)
Images: NASA, ESA/Hubble
Videos: NASA, ESA/Hubble
Animations: NASA, ESA/Hubble, M. Kornmesser
Music: Johan B. Monell (www.johanmonell.com)
Web and technical support: Mathias André and Raquel Yumi Shida
Executive producer: Lars Lindberg Christensen}}{{closed captions}} |date=2017-04-20 |source=[https://spacetelescope.org/videos/hubblecast100a/ Hubblecast 100: Best of Hubblecast] |author=NASA, ESA/Hubble |permission={{ESA-Hubble}} |other_versions= |other_fields= }} [[Category:Hubblecast]] [[Category:WebM videos]] [[Category:Uploaded with video2commons]] [[Category:Video display resolution 1920 x 1080]] [[Category:Videos of 2017|0420]] [[Category:NASA videos in 2017]]
